purpose: Prevent local implementations or agent actions from violating global KEX/BRAINK runtime architecture.

invariants.name: Resident host ownership
invariants.rule: A production runtime service must be owned by a resident server/daemon/runtime substrate. Source-control automation may validate or distribute source but may not be the liveness dependency.

invariants.name: Current-generation lifecycle identity
invariants.rule: A service may be promoted RUNNING/LIVE only when the observed child PID/generation belongs to the current supervisor/controller and current launch attempt.

invariants.name: Evidence non-substitution
invariants.rule: Test output, source commit, workflow status, static artifact, or stale sidecar may not substitute for current execution/readback evidence.

invariants.name: Least authority
invariants.rule: Authentication proves caller identity; scoped capability proves action/target authority. Credentials are never forwarded to unrelated readback origins.

invariants.name: Single idempotency owner
invariants.rule: One logical command has one durable idempotency coordinator. Facades may delegate but may not independently reserve the same command in a second registry.

invariants.name: Workbook semantic boundedness
invariants.rule: Semantic indexing must operate on bounded resident cell objects/ranges and must reject or limit pathological worksheet dimensions; mutation must refresh or invalidate semantic sidecars.

invariants.name: Substrate containment
invariants.rule: Every discovered or migrated filesystem object is resolved and containment-checked individually; escaped symlinks are rejected/skipped without poisoning unrelated discovery.

invariants.name: Proof lineage preservation
invariants.rule: Resident ledgers are never deleted or repurposed by tests. Test ledgers are isolated. Delivered participant receipts and retained checkpoints are append-preserving and may not silently overwrite contradictory evidence.

invariants.name: TL2 scope promotion
invariants.rule: TL2_LIVE requires resident current-generation service liveness and inside-tunnel readback. It does not require or imply PUBLIC_LIVE.

invariants.name: Self-sustaining recovery
invariants.rule: Runtime controller owns health cadence, supervisor recovery, local hostile oracles, proof emission and continuation state. External CI failure cannot terminate or suspend the resident runtime.

agent_execution_rule: Every new function or mutation must identify the applicable invariants before implementation and must emit a defect rather than silently bypassing an invariant.
promotion_rule: No capability claim may exceed the strongest invariant-backed receipt currently observed.
